name: Home To Home
region_note: REHOMING A PET YOURSELF - placing a pet directly with a new family instead of a shelter, from the Mayor's Alliance surrender page
notes: A free way of rehoming a pet yourself. Lists your pet for adopters near you so it can move straight from your home to a new one, permanently or for a while, without a shelter stay. New York, NY is one of its areas.
type_raw: Free online platform for placing a pet directly with a new home
